name: shigetosidumeda-cyber/autonomath-mcp
description: Japanese public-program evidence MCP — 11,601 searchable programs (補助金/融資/税制/認定) + 9,484 e-Gov laws + 22,258 enforcement detail rows + 13,801 国税庁 invoice registrants (PDL v1.0 attribution) + 503,930 corporate entities + 6.12M facts. 139 tools at protocol 2025-06-18 (stdio). Every evidence packet preserves `source_url`, `source_fetched_at`, `known_gaps`. Anonymous tier 3 req/day per IP free (JST reset, no key); metered ¥3 per billable unit (税込 ¥3.30), no SKU tiers. Install: `uvx autonomath-mcp` or `pip install autonomath-mcp`. Active on the official MCP Registry as `io.github.shigetosidumeda-cyber/autonomath-mcp` v0.3.4.
